positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies used, listed by most frequently used first: PHP 7.1 (Laravel), ES7 and Node.js, MySQL, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, PHPUnit and Codeception, MongoDB, Vitess, Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana.

• On a team of ~14 engineers, I work closely with the CTO, product managers, and customer support teams to support Stitch Labs' complex inventory-sync APIs, which process up to 300 customer orders and 6000 requests per minute (both public and internal API traffic), and $4.5 billion in annual transaction volume.

• I integrate new API features and resources, fortify and debug existing ones, and port complex legacy "founder code" over to the modern Laravel codebase and auxiliary services as needed.

• Since August 2019, I’ve been on the 3rd Party Logistics team of 3 engineers, using Node.js and MongoDB to help rapidly build custom 3rd party warehouse software integrations to Stitch and grow the customer base.

• Occasionally required to communicate directly with customers and cover on-call PagerDuty shifts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack software engineer for WaterSmart's SaaS platform, primarily using these technologies: Python, PHP, JavaScript, JQuery, MySQL, RabbitMQ, Chef, HTML/CSS.

• Design, build & test WaterSmart platform features across the application stack.
• Design, build & test backend data storage and analytics code (used: Python, RabbitMQ, Rackspace, AWS, MySQL, DynamoDB, Cassandra).
• Create, maintain & optimize database schemas and queries in MySQL (for special data sets, recently moved from Cassandra to DynamoDB).
• Build front-end user interfaces that communicate with the backend, following visual mockups and our designers' specifications (used: Javascript, jQuery, HTML, CSS).
• Regularly participate in code reviews and feature design discussions with peers.
• Perform customer data onboarding through direct communication with customers.
• Regularly monitor and maintain cloud infrastructure (Rackspace, more recently AWS).

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Added mission-critical features to WaterSmart's platform, which supports millions of daily users, built on top of the “Yii” PHP framework.

• Pushed code to production during my first week.

• Participated in regular code reviews using GitHub + Phabricator.

• Integrated several new features that are still used today, including Intercom, a 3rd party customer messaging platform, into the system using JS and PHP APIs and SDKs.

• Built and enhanced real-time data visualization charts & graphs using open source JS libraries.

• Reported my progress to colleagues during standup meetings twice a week.

• Worked mostly independently during the course of my internship.
